rows.label: Total solar irradiance at 1 AU
rows.quote: The most accurate value of total solar irradiance during the 2008 solar minimum period is 1360.8 ± 0.5 W m-2

rows.label: Irradiance scaling
rows.quote: Inverse-square law; r is the Sun range from the ephemeris. About ±3.4% over a year (1408 W/m2 at perihelion, 1317 at aphelion).

rows.label: Cold-trap threshold
rows.quote: Annual maximum temperature below 110 K, as used by Li et al. 2018 (filter) and Fisher et al. 2017 (reflectance transition).
rows.note: Surface ice exposures were found in only about 3.5% of cold traps (Li et al. 2018). Never call a cold trap 'ice-bearing'.
